column1: # Hand conversions (plan 06 §13.3 steps 4–5, plan 01 §7.5): the 13 keys (38 messages across en, ar, es, zh) that
# CMP XML cannot hold as one resource. The l10n owner chose each rewrite; `strings convert` applies it to every
# language, and `strings check` redoes it. A refused message with no row here still fails the run.

#   split-plurals  → <key> keeps the sentence, each plural becomes <plurals name="<key>__<count>">;
#                    HandWords.<key>(…) / <key>Text(…) compose it. Nothing about the sentence changes with a count.
